description: Hatch-Choate consistency: fit log Dm, ln sigma_g, log M0 and derive Dg and AMD from them (fewer free outputs)

model.formula: size_j = ridge(material one-hot + log1p(aging)/7 + no_flow + 5(Rt/R0-1.35)); logit P_j = same design, L2 logistic (C=1)
model.notes: Ridge on log Dm, ln sigma_g, log M0; Dg and AMD derived by Hatch-Choate. Per-target alpha by GCV; logistic C by inner 5-fold Brier.
